POP:-
1- Its code is a sequence of functions acting on data.
2- The concentration is on functions not data.
3- In a multifunction programs, it defines some data be global
in order to be used by multiple functions. That makes
absolute no restrictions on using data which increases
the possibility of being corrupted by misusing.
When the program becomes much larger it is
very difficult to determine for data used by
those functions.
4- They are described as code acting on data.

OOP:-
1- The code is a messages between objects
which hold data and defining functions called
on that data.
2- The concentration is on data rather than
functions
3- The data are grouped into objects which
define the functions called on this data and make
restrictions on access and modifying this data.
4- The code can be described as data controlling
functions.

3- Inheritance is done used in class definition.

by concentrate on only specific details of the class,
and transfer but polymorphism and enables programmer
in calling methods to concentrate on the function of

action of the method regardless of the specific object calls it.
